fields.why: Reported claims rest on state-specific Poisson trends in year, i.e. a series over time by group, which the brief calls comparison; the overall model controlling for state has no reported results.
State-level models contain only year (the exposure) and a population offset; the offset is normalization, not covariate adjustment, and B wrongly lists event year as a confounder.

brief_issues: Could state explicitly that an unreported auxiliary model (here the overall model controlling for state) does not make depth stratified/adjusted.
